No new version of Ancile for 3 months

Unfortunately I haven't had a lot of time to dedicate to Ancile. I have been trying to keep an eye on Windows updates, and I think Ancile is up to date with everything that MS has released. MS has really been focusing all their effort on Win 10 lately, so updates for Win 7 & 8 have slowed down. I haven't heard of any major telemetry updates that have been pushed to 7 or 8.

 

Fortunately, the latest version of Ancile (https://voat.co/v/Ancile/1677949)) will auto update a number of plugins (Including Windows Updates) each time it's run. This means that when MS releases an update I just update the data files, and there's no need to do a full Ancile release. If you haven't run Ancile in the past 3 months, you may want to give it a go.

 

I have pushed a few minor updates to the Ancile repos, but nothing that's worthy of putting out a new version. If you're brave enough, you can head over to https://bitbucket.org/ancile_development/ancile, download the build scripts, and use "ancilerelease.sh" to build Ancile with the latest updates. Careful, this will be an unstable build and may not work as expected.
